sources.label: Amazon Associates — program home page (public)
sources.supports: Public statement 'Earn up to 10% in associate commissions'; commission differs by category; paid approximately 60 days after month end

sources.label: Amazon Associates Help — Application Review Process
sources.supports: At least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days; original content; 'good rule of thumb is at least 10 posts'; tagged-link rejection reason

sources.label: Amazon Creators API — Introduction
sources.supports: Creators API operations; prerequisite of at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days

sources.label: Amazon PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice
sources.supports: PA-API 5 deprecated in favour of Creators API; continued PA-API 5 calls return HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException

sources.label: The Operating Agreement — Top Dos and Don'ts
sources.supports: Approved disclosure language (#paidlink, #ad, CommissionsEarned, 'As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases'); required trademark statement 'Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.'

sources.label: FTC — Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Disclosure timing/placement; 'You can't talk about your experience with a product you haven't tried.'

sources.label: FTC — Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking (affiliate-marketing Q&A)
sources.supports: 'I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post' example; 'affiliate link' and 'buy now' inadequate alone; 'paid link' adequate next to the link

sources.label: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.supports: §255.3 expert endorsements; §255.4(b)(3)(i) affiliate-funded review sites must disclose; §255.5(a) material-connection disclosure

sources.label: 16 CFR Part 465 — Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials
